title: MCP testing and proof-checking simulation
headline: The hosted MCP server matched origin/main on all 100 test calls and passed 93 of them, and seeded simulations agreed with all three Lean results tested (neutral fixation i/M, fixation at least i/M for s >= 0, twofold cost of sex). On Windows, the local MCP server and CLI fail on every TriG query.

metrics.label: neutral fixation cells consistent with i/M
selection cells at or above i/M

needs.ask: Fix mcp/lib.mjs line 73: it puts Windows backslash paths inside IRIs, so the local MCP server and CLI fail on Windows. Converting the relative path to forward slashes fixes it, as tested. The shared tree is also 372 commits behind origin/main.
